body:
# Codex coding overnight: 4 October 2026

Owner: coding chat `01a10869-c3c8-7272-9b7e-57e747ddc312`. State: IN_PROGRESS.

Read the master brief first, AGENTS, current implementation/generation/art specifications, delivery board, overnight handoff, active Turning Ravine report and frozen engine API. Preserve all existing dirty work and historical evidence.

Exact initial claim CODE-PANELS-20261004: new `expeditions/v2/ui/BalancePanel.jsx`, `NonogramPanel.jsx`, `PackingPanel.jsx`, `family-panels.test.js` and this report. No existing production file edits in this batch. Read mailbox before and after each batch; actor codex, CODE subject prefix and originating chat ID. Do not acknowledge another writer's messages.

Build independent panels consuming existing puzzle content and callbacks: `onEdit(edit)` emits frozen edit payloads; `onCommand(type,payload)` emits `compare-loads` only. Panels do not activate a mechanism or compute tactical outcomes. Free draft versus adjacent paid activation stays with the existing parent UI. Integration into PuzzlePanel waits for explicit legacy release. Tests are component/jsdom and mathematical hook checks, never browser/device/child evidence.

Current active legacy claims remain untouched: TURNING-RAVINE-20261003 and final-build. No generation, engine, App, save, art registry or shared HTML writes. Claude owns generator packets and final build.

## Batch 1: standalone panels ready

Five targeted component tests pass: balance DOM events execute through the real reducer and replay; edits/comparisons preserve hero AP and committed puzzle/output state; hidden totals use only printed or inferred values; exhausted comparison allowance permits recorded repeats; nonogram gives adjacent clues and immutable givens; packing supports keyboard anchors, six rotations, tier-gated reflection, illegal-placement feedback and a full solver packing through actual input events. These are jsdom/hook/reducer tests using explicit test fixtures, not browser or certified mission evidence. Initial sandbox bundler access failed; the same narrowly scoped check ran successfully with escalation. One test expectation incorrectly counted the initial reserve subtotal and was corrected.

## Batch 2 claim after explicit release

Legacy mailbox `1791142879019-ff6051e8693c` explicitly releases the Turning Ravine files. No lock inferred from elapsed time. Add exact claim CODE-FAMILY-UI-20261004: `expeditions/v2/ui/PuzzlePanel.jsx` and this existing test/report only for integrating the new family panels and fixed-output handling. Other UI files remain read-only until another exact claim. Art retains its renderer/EquationWheel/import boundary. Claude receives current stable source without shared-output rebuild from this worker.

Seven panel tests and five existing wheel UI checks now pass together (12/12). Fixed balance/packing outputs cannot be deselected; selectable Roost beams retain Save circuit choices. Activation invokes the existing preview callback only. The test bundle registers its own hooks, matching the real route; malformed minimal test metadata was completed rather than patching production to accommodate it.

## Batch 3 exact claim

Add released `ui/action-guide.js`, `ui/next-step.js`, `ui/Briefing.jsx` and `ui/feedback.js` to CODE-FAMILY-UI-20261004 for family-specific instruction/feedback and fixed-output readiness. Current `mechanismReady` compares active count against undefined `poweredCount` for balance/packing and always returns false; correct this against existing commission `poweredIds` and real hook commission checks. No core ABI change. Tests stay in the already owned `family-panels.test.js`. Independent mathematical clue/hint review may follow in separately claimed puzzle files.

Art message `1791143001259-d6429f4e7f9b` read: station resolver stable, existing ABI, requests refreshed browser review after final-build owner supplies preview. No art-file writes from coding. Browser review remains pending.

21 focused checks pass after family guidance/readiness/feedback changes. All engine-derived commission context is passed to real hooks, including suppressed packing sockets. Completion remains REVIEW, no family/runtime promotion or full shared build.

## Priority batch 4: original portrait/team frame

Sam's new UX direction from scrum is explicit: original portrait in the round part, names/stats in a separate proper text box. Exact claim CODE-PARTY-FRAME-20261004: new `ui/PartyTray.jsx`, `ui/party-tray.test.js`, existing `ui/OrchardExpedition.jsx`, `ui/recovery.css.js` and `ui/MissionSetup.jsx` for shared portrait source resolution and frame composition. No existing renderer/import/art writes. Read actual original card-art mapping and approved hero frame; art owns safe-area geometry/asset preparation. Original `avatarForCard('primary',card)` prop is already provided by App and used in setup; consume it in the in-game tray instead of battlefield sprite `orchardPortraitFor`. Missing original art gets an explicit textual fallback, never a sprite substitute.

Confirmed existing heroFrame is a rectangular double nameplate with no circular opening. Art supplied new ui-kit team frame and metadata in message `1791143597026-b43e4b35606b`. PartyTray consumes exact exported geometry and artwork. Uniform display viewport trims only transparent outer margins [41,0,470,169]; artwork remains uniformly scaled, source unchanged. Name and compact health/AP occupy the separate safe rectangle; full stats/role remain in Party drawer and accessible title. Setup uses the same original portrait resolver, no battlefield fallback.

Additional exclusive QA files: `scripts/dev/party-frame-preview.jsx`, `scripts/dev/build-party-frame-preview.cjs`, evidence under `docs/expeditions/v2/evidence/code-overnight-20261004/`. This is an isolated component bundle and disposable QA fixture, not a shared app rebuild, certified mission or winning playthrough. No legacy preview overwrite. Actual browser viewport checks will be labelled separately from jsdom.

## Team frame browser evidence

Actual browser checks at 390×844, 768×1024 and 1280×720 pass in the isolated component fixture. Original artwork fills the round opening, text stays in the separate painted area; long name wraps in two lines. DOM measurements: phone safe text 144×44, scrollHeight44; tablet 160×49, scrollHeight49. Portrait and text regions do not overlap. Actual clicks select the exhausted Longshadow; defeated Ninebark is disabled. Phone/tablet scroll the three-card tray; desktop displays all three. Saved JPEGs `party-phone-long-name.jpg`, `party-tablet-long-name.jpg`, `party-desktop-states.jpg` in the claimed evidence directory. This is real browser component evidence, not production mission/device/child acceptance. The targeted suite with PartyTray, panels and existing UI passes17/17. Original route portrait props still needed for live mission screenshot; Claude notified.

Additional ready UX claim: new `ui/PaintedActionButton.jsx`, `ui/painted-action.test.js`, existing `ui/AbilityHand.jsx`, already claimed `OrchardExpedition.jsx` and `recovery.css.js` for proper painted action/ability controls using art's exact safe areas. The help ? control must remain its own compact live control. Add isolated action fixtures to the owned frame preview for responsive browser checks. No art/engine/shared-output writes.

Painted action controls now wired into contextual/all-actions/ability hand and Puzzle/Undo/End round; icon/copy use art's exact independent safe areas. Selected, focus, pressed, spent and unavailable artwork read the stable art kit. Help remains a separate44px compact control; ability purpose/stat/target/failure opens only on request. Actual phone/tablet/desktop browser action captures saved as `actions-phone-activation.jpg`, `actions-tablet-states.jpg`, `actions-desktop-states.jpg`. Activation click selects preview in the isolated fixture; no action spending or reducer win is claimed. Long activation label fits its47.328px safe height: first text top475.09, final text bottom520.06 versus area473.92..521.25. Integer scrollHeight rounds to48, but actual child rects remain inside. Browser override reset.

Claude's recovery regression note consumed: preserve previous trust of production `puzzleValid` for Sudoku/balance/nonogram and use extra commission hooks only for rotation and packing. Existing recovery fixture unchanged and4/4pass. Combined recovery/family/painted checks16/16pass. Party/wheel/private UI scoped check14/14pass. Reserve benefit truth is now published as allocation-derived by Claude engine; drawer uses planned.valid for derived draft readiness, activeOutputs for actual map state. No selection is added. Cornix/Millrace/Longshadow original portrait crop uses50%0% per art review; all other defaults50%38%.
